diffs.reason: "ἀλλ' οὐδενὸς λόγου ποιοῦμαι τὴν ψυχήν μου τιμίαν ἐμαυτῷ" = "I do not count my life as precious." G3762 is attributive modifying λόγου (G3056, N-GSM), forming the fixed idiom "λόγου ποιέομαι" (count as / make account of). With "οὐδενός" prefix = "of no account/worth." This is NOT a person reference — the referent is abstract value. 誰も〜ない (no one) is incorrect; 何も〜ない (nothing/no account) is closer.
